verifier_summary: I reran all ten m3 check scripts against ledger revision 3, and every derived step S9-S57 was checked by at least one script that ran. Every check passes: 118 claims, no failures, so there are no findings this round. The two failures from try 2 (premises missing from S12, S21 and S22, and nothing stating that T_ref is constant) are fixed in the ledger. Before rerunning, I tightened the T_ref check so the symbols table no longer counts; only an assumption that S13 cites does. I also added three planted-error cases for the try-3 changes, and all 59 planted errors are caught. The toy has no water, so the conservation check covers energy instead; the ψ ≡ 1 comparison with src/assembly.c line 183 differs only by the source term q.
